title: NVIDIA expands free access to 80+ AI models with instant API keys #nvidia #aimodels #aiaccess
description: NVIDIA launched free access to over 80 leading AI models, including Kimi, Minimax, GLM, DeepSeek, and OpenAI, all available through Build by NVIDIA. Users can generate API keys instantly for seamless integration with platforms like Claude Code and Cursor, eliminating the need to pay for individual AI API keys. This initiative simplifies AI development by centralizing access to diverse models in one place, accelerating innovation and experimentation within the AI community. It also lowers the barrier to entry for developers and businesses seeking to incorporate AI functionalities without upfront costs. By democratizing AI model access, NVIDIA supports a wider adoption of AI technology across industries, fostering rapid growth in AI-powered applications and services globally. #NVIDIA #BuildByNVIDIA #AIModels #FreeAIAPI #KimiAI #Minimax #GLM #DeepSeek #OpenAI #ClaudeCode #CursorAI #AIDevelopment #AIInnovation #TechAccess #ArtificialIntelligence #APIAccess
